tldr: A fixed finite roster is uniformly partitioned into equal groups and half the groups are treated. Every unit has arbitrary fixed bounded potential outcomes indexed by its own group arm and composition, as in the anchor's Outcome Case 1. Exact group averaging identifies the homogeneous-size PAME with \(\tau_h\) and the individual difference in means with \(\widehat\tau_h\); its onto map preserves the entire table cube. The first completed contribution is the universal actual-variance bound \(d_K(F_h/\sigma_h,\Phi)\le\min\{1,CM/\sigma_h\}\), with an all-coordinate \(b^{-1/2}\) lower bound and separate necessary and sufficient conditions. Observed guarded group-Neyman intervals are conservatively valid when \(\sigma_h^2\ge vG\) and \(M=o(\sqrt G)\). The second completed contribution is certified finite upper and lower evaluation of the compatible group-cell quadratic-majorant relative-excess loss to any positive tolerance, together with an attaining majorant. It concerns expected conservativeness, with no concentration or Wald-coverage claim for the optimized estimator.
